DUAN YIXUAN / 段艺璇

WEIBO ↗

Duan Yixuan’s work spans live stage performance and solo pop releases. Her “What about us” stage was presented in 2023. In 2025, she and HYBRIDGENE released 不完美大人·出逃计划, a six-song project accompanied by six instrumental versions.

HYBRIDGENE

WEIBO ↗

HYBRIDGENE is credited alongside Duan Yixuan across the 2025 release 不完美大人·出逃计划. The project opens with “不完美大人” and includes “火花”, “最后的独角兽”, “未命名关系”, “住在海边的猫” and “逃出宇宙的尽头”, followed by their instrumental versions.
